scripts.changeset-release: cp README.md packages/react-native-healthkit && bunx changeset publish
scripts.codegen: bun run build:core && bun run codegen:healthkit && bun run codegen:health-records && cd apps/example/ios && pod install
scripts.codegen:healthkit: bun run build:core && cd packages/react-native-healthkit && rm -rf nitrogen/generated && bun run nitrogen && bun run build:plugin && cd ../../ && bun run fix-codegen
scripts.codegen:health-records: bun run build:core && cd packages/health-records && rm -rf nitrogen/generated && bun run nitrogen && bun run build:plugin && cd ../../ && bun run fix-codegen:health-records
scripts.build:plugins: bun run build:core && bun scripts/build-app-plugin.ts packages/react-native-healthkit packages/health-records
scripts.reinstall: rm -rf node_modules/ && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && bun install
scripts.reinstall-with-nuked-lockfile: rm -rf node_modules/ && rm bun.lock && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && bun install
